subject: Mathematics
title: Application of Integrals
summary: A definite integral gives area under a curve: area between y = f(x), the x-axis and x = a, b is ∫ₐᵇ |f(x)| dx.
Area between two curves is ∫ (upper − lower) dx between their intersection points; sometimes integrating with respect to y (right − left) is easier.
Sketch first: find intersection points, see which curve is on top, and split the interval wherever the curves cross or the function changes sign.

formulas.name: Area under a curve
formulas.when: Area between a curve and the x-axis.
formulas.note: If f changes sign, split at its zeros — otherwise areas cancel.

formulas.name: Area between curves
formulas.formula: A = ∫ₐᵇ [f(x) − g(x)] dx  with f ≥ g on [a, b]

formulas.name: Circle
formulas.formula: area of x² + y² = a² = πa²

formulas.name: Parabola and its latus rectum
formulas.formula: area bounded by y² = 4ax and x = a = 8a²/3

formulas.name: Parabola and line
formulas.formula: area between y = x² and y = x = 1/6;  between y² = 4ax and y = mx = 8a²/(3m³)

formulas.name: Symmetry
formulas.formula: use symmetry about the axes to compute one part and multiply
formulas.when: Saving work for circles, ellipses, parabolas.

formulas.name: One arch of sine
formulas.when: Area of one arch of y = sin x.

topics.title: Sketching tips
topics.explain: Mark intercepts, intersection points and symmetry. Shade the region asked; decide vertical strips (dx) or horizontal strips (dy) — choose the one needing fewer pieces.

topics.title: Curves crossing the axis
topics.explain: For y = sin x on [0, 2π], the signed integral is 0 but the area is 4. Always use |f(x)| or split at zeros.

topics.title: Modulus and greatest integer curves
topics.explain: Areas with |x| or [x] are found by splitting at break points, often giving triangles and rectangles that can be computed geometrically.

topics.title: Inequality regions
topics.explain: Regions like {(x, y): x² ≤ y ≤ |x|} are found by identifying boundary curves and their intersections, then integrating upper minus lower.

topics.title: Area via definite integral properties
topics.explain: King's property and symmetry from definite integrals can simplify area calculations.

topics.title: Area between a curve and the y-axis
topics.explain: For x = g(y) between y = c and y = d, integrate g(y) dy. Example: area between x = y² and the y-axis from y = 0 to 2 is 8/3.
